description: This Java class implements the Transaction data access object (DAO) for the payment processing module, extending generic DAO functionalities and providing a method to list transactions by a specific order.

classes.name: TransactionDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of TransactionDao, providing methods to query Transaction entities from the database, specifically listing transactions linked to a specific order.

methods.name: listByOrder
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Transaction entities associated with a given Order object by executing a JPQL query.
